//: Story Phase 8 crew dialogue, one script per crew member per story state (w1 trapped below; w2 the false alarm; w3 the sash bearers; w4 the Lost Fart nonsense; w5 the old quarters; w6 building the barracks; w7 lights out; w8 the crown came down; w9 the sash; w10 after, at three in the morning), plus hints while an objective waits on somebody else (selectors in data/npcs/phase8_crew.json).
hale.p8_hint_corner: hale: Sit down, Captain. Your corner. Squawks has been keeping it warm.
hale.p8_hint_ask: hale: Ask him, Captain. Somebody has to. It's you.
hale.p8_hint_squawks: hale[alarmed]: The PARROT, Captain! Get the parrot!
hale.p8_hint_hatch: hale[alarmed]: The STAIRS, Captain! Everyone to the hatch! Don't OPEN it!
hale.p8_hint_proposal: hale: He's looking at the sash again, Captain. Go and see. Before he comes to us.
hale.p8_hint_verdict: hale: Go and tell him, Captain. Nobody. Not a single one of us.
hale.p8_hint_crown: hale: (whispering) Put it somewhere it can't fall, Captain. A crate. A deep one.
hale.p8_hint_premise: hale: He wants to tell you the 'adventure', Captain. Better you than us.
hale.p8_hint_back: hale: (whispering) Back to bed, Captain. Try. We're all trying.
hale.p8_hint_bed: hale: Into your bunk, Captain. Quick. Before he finds a book.
hale.p8_w10_1: hale[resigned]: Log entry: 'Grand Stenchmaster Sash. Origin: discount bin. Seventy per cent off.' I've never been so happy to write anything.
hale.p8_w10_2: hale: Three in the morning, and I'm worried about a frog's capital gains. Put THAT in the log. ...I did.
hale.p8_w9: hale: (whispering) Did he say last WEEK, Captain? I need to get this down exactly.
hale.p8_w8: hale[resigned]: (whispering) Cutlery. In the log. Under 'incidents'. Next to 'sharks'.
hale.p8_w7: hale: Lights down, Captain. If he starts anything, I'm pretending to be asleep. I'm very good at it.
hale.p8_w6: hale[happy]: Rope, Captain! Pass me the rope! ...I haven't been this happy since the storm came back.
hale.p8_w5: hale[disgusted]: 'Centuries.' I'm not writing centuries. I'm writing 'indefinitely', and underlining it.
hale.p8_w4: hale[resigned]: I've been asked to log the Lost Fart as an 'archaeological matter'. I've logged it as 'Garrick'.
hale.p8_w3: hale[annoyed]: 'Sash bearers.' I've put it in the log. I've put a question mark after it. Then another one.
hale.p8_w2: hale[alarmed]: Somebody ASK him, Captain. I need to know what to write.
hale.p8_w1_1: hale[resigned]: Day and a half, Captain. I've started logging the landings. Big ones get a cross. Expensive ones get two.
hale.p8_w1_2: hale: The Mark II's been on for nineteen hours. I've logged that too. Under 'morale'. I don't know why.

wick.p8_hint_quarters: wick: The quarters, Captain! Up to the galley! Our own hammocks!
wick.p8_hint_back: wick: (whispering) Back to bed, Captain. Try. We're all trying.
wick.p8_hint_bed: wick: Into your bunk, Captain. Quick. Before he finds a book.
wick.p8_w10: wick[happy]: I'll wash the sash, Captain. Properly. Hot. Then it'll be a three-coin sash that smells of soap, and he'll be FURIOUS.
wick.p8_w9: wick: (whispering) Seventy per cent off. I could've told him. The stitching on that sash. Dreadful.
wick.p8_w8: wick[sad]: (whispering) A spoon hit me, Captain. On the way past. Ricocheted.
wick.p8_w7: wick: This is all right, actually. ...Don't tell Hale I said that.
wick.p8_w6: wick[happy]: Bagsy the blue hammock, Captain. Nobody's had the blue one before. It's never been blue AND clean.
wick.p8_w5: wick: My spare shirts are in there. My good apron. Gone. Mustard now, all of it.
wick.p8_w4: wick: 'Professor Barnacle Bob.' He's had that hat on an hour and he's started squinting at things.
wick.p8_w3: wick[disgusted]: Hold it? I've WASHED that sash, Captain. Once. I'm not going near it again. It fought back.
wick.p8_w2: wick[alarmed]: Is it happening? Is it happening NOW? I've only got the one clean shirt!
wick.p8_w1: wick: Day and a half in the same shirt, Captain. I can tell you exactly where I've been. So can everyone.

fennimore.p8_hint_crown: fennimore: (whispering) Put it somewhere it can't fall, Captain. A crate. A deep one.
fennimore.p8_w10: fennimore: Diagnosis: a shared trauma, a frog, and no sleep. Prognosis: we'll be fine. Probably. Pass the biscuits.
fennimore.p8_w9: fennimore[surprised]: (whispering) Sleep-talking's quite common. CONFESSING in your sleep... that's rarer. That's a gift.
fennimore.p8_w8: fennimore: (whispering) Any injuries, Captain? ...No? From a falling crown? Remarkable. I'll write it up.
fennimore.p8_w7: fennimore: If this story runs long, Captain, I'll prescribe sleep. Firmly.
fennimore.p8_w6: fennimore: A hammock, at last. Better for the back than a crate. Slightly worse for the dignity.
fennimore.p8_w5: fennimore[disgusted]: 'Embedded contamination.' I'm a doctor, Captain, and I wouldn't go in there with a bucket on my head.
fennimore.p8_w4: fennimore[concerned]: 'Digestive authority.' I've been a doctor twenty years. That isn't a thing. I've checked.
fennimore.p8_w3: fennimore: I'll volunteer as medical support, Captain. From the other end of the hold.
fennimore.p8_w2: fennimore[alarmed]: Medically I can't tell either, Captain. Nobody can. That's what frightens me.
fennimore.p8_w1: fennimore: As the ship's doctor I'd prescribe fresh air. As a realist, I'd prescribe a peg on the nose.

rook.p8_w10: rook[happy]: Gristle gave me my belt back, Captain. Well. A belt. Not mine. I'm not asking.
rook.p8_w9: rook: (whispering) Last week. LAST WEEK. Weeks of 'ancient'.
rook.p8_w8: rook[alarmed]: (whispering) I thought it was a shark, Captain. I was READY for a shark. I was not ready for a spoon.
rook.p8_w7: rook[annoyed]: My trousers keep falling down. I'll get to the bottom of it. After the story.
rook.p8_w6: rook[alarmed]: Has anyone seen my belt? ...Gristle's got a lot of belts on that bed, Captain. A LOT of belts.
rook.p8_w5: rook[disgusted]: I'll get the nails. And more nails. And planks. Lots of planks.
rook.p8_w4: rook[annoyed]: I'm not in this adventure, Captain. I've checked. Good.
rook.p8_w3: rook: Hold the sash? I'd rather hold a cannon. Lit.
rook.p8_w2: rook[alarmed]: Which way's the hatch? Which way's the HATCH?
rook.p8_w1: rook[annoyed]: I've counted the planks over my head, Captain. Forty-one. There were forty-three this morning.

sully.p8_hint_back: sully: (whispering) Back to bed, Captain. Try. We're all trying.
sully.p8_hint_bed: sully: Into your bunk, Captain. Quick. Before he finds a book.
sully.p8_w10: sully: I'm carving a new little ship, Captain. Down here. For the barracks. With a frog on the sail.
sully.p8_w9: sully: (whispering) No receipt. I'd have kept the receipt. You always keep the receipt.
sully.p8_w8: sully: (whispering) Fork came through the canvas, Captain? Right through? I'll patch it in the morning.
sully.p8_w7: sully: Lovely bit of rigging, this. Shame about the man in the top one.
sully.p8_w6: sully[happy]: Knot here, Captain, and here. There. That'll hold an elephant. Or Garrick. Probably not Garrick.
sully.p8_w5: sully[disgusted]: The old quarters, gone. All my carving's in there. The little ship. Mustard now.
sully.p8_w4: sully[sad]: Six inches of wet floor. Bottomless Ravine. I stood in it this morning. It's a ravine now, apparently.
sully.p8_w3: sully: I'd rather hold the anchor, Captain. Underwater. For a week.
sully.p8_w2: sully[alarmed]: Where do we GO, Captain? There's no WHERE. That's the whole problem with a hold.
sully.p8_w1: sully: Two planks, Captain. That last one. Pete's right. He's always right about planks now.

brask.p8_hint_crown: brask: (whispering) Put it somewhere it can't fall, Captain. A crate. A deep one.
brask.p8_w10: brask: Three in the morning and I'm worried about a frog's taxes, Captain. Never been worried about my own.
brask.p8_w9: brask: (whispering) Seventy per cent off. I've been SALUTING that.
brask.p8_w8: brask[alarmed]: (whispering) I nearly shot the crown, Captain. In the dark. I'd have been in the right.
brask.p8_w7: brask: If he says 'Grand' once more tonight, Captain, I'm going to count to ten. Very loudly.
brask.p8_w6: brask: Hammock's up. Pistol's under the pillow. Sharks, frogs, Garricks: I'm ready for anything.
brask.p8_w5: brask: I could shoot the door. ...Wouldn't help. Would make a hole. Holes are bad. Understood.
brask.p8_w4: brask[annoyed]: A temple shaped like his belly. I could shoot the temple. ...It's imaginary. Still.
brask.p8_w3: brask: I'll pay, Captain. To NOT hold it. I've four coins. Name your price.
brask.p8_w2: brask[alarmed]: Do I shoot it? Can you shoot a fart? ...Don't answer that.
brask.p8_w1: brask[annoyed]: Day and a half. I've cleaned my pistol eleven times, Captain. It's very clean. There's nothing to shoot.

gristle.p8_hint_bed: gristle: Into your bunk, Captain. Quick. Before he finds a book.
gristle.p8_w10_1: gristle: He can reconstruct his basis, Captain. Franklin. Flies in, flies out. It's arithmetic. I've worked half of it out on a crate.
gristle.p8_w10_2: gristle[annoyed]: Three coins. For the sash. Three. I've been more ceremonially insulted by things that cost more.
gristle.p8_w9: gristle: (whispering) Told you there'd be a tag. Always a tag.
gristle.p8_w8: gristle[concerned]: (whispering) Cutlery. Of course it was cutlery. I've aged another year.
gristle.p8_w7: gristle[annoyed]: He wants the altitude, Captain. For when it goes. I'm just saying what everyone's thinking.
gristle.p8_w6: gristle: Four belts, half a sail and a fishing net. Best-rigged bed on the ship. Don't ask whose belts.
gristle.p8_w5: gristle[disgusted]: 'The Center is a free spirit.' The Center is a MENACE, and so's he.
gristle.p8_w4: gristle[annoyed]: An adventure. In a hold. Built entirely out of his stomach and our furniture.
gristle.p8_w3: gristle: Absolutely not, and I don't care how ceremonial it is.
gristle.p8_w2: gristle[annoyed]: Ask him. Ask him now. I'd like to know how old I'm going to be by morning.
gristle.p8_w1: gristle[annoyed]: The pulley, Captain. Every time the ship rolls. Thunk. Forty-six. I'm counting.

jory.p8_w10: jory: Can't take it back, Captain. No refunds. We're stuck with it. Like him.
jory.p8_w9: jory: (whispering) A sketchy store. I know the one, I think. Tortuga. Back of the fish market. It smells funny.
jory.p8_w8: jory: (whispering) Is it over? Can I sleep? I'm not going to sleep.
jory.p8_w7: jory: That book's blank, Captain. I saw it. Blank.
jory.p8_w6: jory[happy]: A hammock in the middle, Captain. Like the helm. I can see everything from here.
jory.p8_w5: jory: The quarters? I'll sleep standing up, Captain. At the wheel. When we get back to the wheel.
jory.p8_w4: jory[annoyed]: 'The Corridor of a Thousand Forecasts.' That's his map collection. I've SEEN it. None of them work.
jory.p8_w3: jory: I'll steer, Captain. That's my job. Steering. Not holding. Definitely not holding.
jory.p8_w2: jory[alarmed]: Not the HATCH, Captain! Anywhere but the hatch! There's a STORM on the hatch!
jory.p8_w1: jory: Nothing to steer, Captain. I keep reaching for the wheel. It's three decks up and lashed.
bob.p8_hint_squawks: bob[alarmed]: The PARROT, Captain! Get the parrot!

bob.p8_w10_1: bob: That auditor's too hard on him, Captain. Franklin's doing his best. With a lily pad. Who isn't?
bob.p8_w10_2: bob: Twice, Captain. He made us play the Lost Fart nonsense TWICE. Over a three-coin sash.
bob.p8_w9: bob: (whispering) Where? Where's the store? I want to know where NOT to shop.
bob.p8_w8: bob[alarmed]: (whispering) I thought it was the onion. The big one. Rolling.
bob.p8_w7: bob: If I'm in this story, Captain, I want it noted I wasn't there.
bob.p8_w6: bob[happy]: A cargo net, Captain! Airy! The grog goes straight through! ...So do my legs. A bit.
bob.p8_w5: bob[disgusted]: A bed with a blanket that hasn't got grog in it. That's all I wanted. That's ALL.
bob.p8_w4_1: bob: I'm not a professor, Captain. I can barely read. Don't tell him I said that.
bob.p8_w4_2: bob: The hat's comfy. That's not the POINT.
bob.p8_w3: bob: Still a shark, Captain. I'd still rather.
bob.p8_w2: bob[alarmed]: I'm getting in the cask! I'm GETTING IN THE CASK!
bob.p8_w1: bob[disgusted]: The grog's dripping in my ear, Captain. I moved. It followed me.

ned.p8_w10: ned: Storm's still up there, Captain. I've stopped looking. I've been watching Franklin instead. He needs it more.
ned.p8_w9: ned: (whispering) Lookout's report, Captain: sash, three coins. Over.
ned.p8_w8: ned: (whispering) All clear, Captain. Just a crown. ...Just a crown.
ned.p8_w7: ned: Hammock's grand, Captain. It's the 'Grand' bit I'm worried about.
ned.p8_w6: ned: I'll keep watch from my hammock, Captain. Down here, watch is mostly listening. I'm very good at listening.
ned.p8_w5: ned: I'll watch the door, Captain. From a very long way away.
ned.p8_w4: ned: An Electric Frog Oracle. That's Mark II, Captain. I've watched it all day. It's not prophesying, it's AUDITING.
ned.p8_w3: ned: The Sharkstorm, Captain. By the tail. I've thought it over and I stand by it.
ned.p8_w2: ned[alarmed]: I'll watch for it, Captain! What does it LOOK like? ...Don't tell me.
ned.p8_w1: ned: Nothing to look out for, Captain, but the ceiling. I've been looking out for it. It's still there.

nell.p8_w10: nell: She's quieter now, Captain. The ship. Like she's watching the frog too.
nell.p8_w9: nell: (whispering) Seventy per cent off. Even the hull felt that one.
nell.p8_w8: nell[alarmed]: (whispering) I thought it was the Center come back. It wasn't. It was a SPOON.
nell.p8_w7: nell: The storm's easing, Captain. Not gone. Easing. I'll take easing.
nell.p8_w6: nell[happy]: I can feel the whole ship from this hammock, Captain. She likes it, I think. All of us down here.
nell.p8_w5: nell: The Center's on the forward deck now, Captain. I can feel it. Cold planks up there. It moves. The quarters... don't.
nell.p8_w4: nell[annoyed]: A sacred bridge for a sash. I've crossed real bridges, Captain. None of them wanted a sash.
nell.p8_w3: nell: Sash bearers. No. And I can feel the planks agreeing with me.
nell.p8_w2: nell[alarmed]: The furthest place from him, Captain! That's where we're going! That's the PLAN!
nell.p8_w1: nell: I can feel the ship through the boards, Captain. She's holding. Sore, but holding.

finch.p8_hint_bed: finch: Into your bunk, Captain. Quick. Before he finds a book.
finch.p8_w10: finch[happy]: Nobody's sleeping, Captain, so I mopped. Then I sat down for the frog. Then I forgot the mop.
finch.p8_w9: finch: (whispering) A discount bin. I've had better from a discount bin. I've had a MOP.
finch.p8_w8: finch: (whispering) I'll sweep the spoons up in the morning, Captain.
finch.p8_w7: finch: Quiet hours, Captain. I like quiet hours. Do you think we'll get any?
finch.p8_w6: finch[happy]: Floor's clear, Captain! Real floor! I'm going to mop it twice, for luck.
finch.p8_w5: finch[disgusted]: I'm not mopping in there. I mop floors. That's a WEATHER system.
finch.p8_w4: finch: I mopped the Bottomless Ravine, Captain. It's not bottomless now. It's not even damp.
finch.p8_w3: finch: No, Captain. Not with a mop on a pole. Not with a very long pole.
finch.p8_w2: finch[alarmed]: Get the BUCKET! ...What's the bucket for? I don't KNOW! Get it anyway!
finch.p8_w1: finch: Nothing to swab, Captain, so I've swabbed the ceiling. As far as I can reach.
pete.p8_hint_squawks: pete[alarmed]: The PARROT, Captain! Get the parrot!
pete.p8_hint_hatch: pete[alarmed]: The STAIRS, Captain! Everyone to the hatch! Don't OPEN it!
pete.p8_hint_proposal: pete: He's looking at the sash again, Captain. Go and see. Before he comes to us.
pete.p8_hint_verdict: pete: Go and tell him, Captain. Nobody. Not a single one of us.
pete.p8_hint_crown: pete: (whispering) Put it somewhere it can't fall, Captain. A crate. A deep one.
pete.p8_hint_premise: pete: He wants to tell you the 'adventure', Captain. Better you than us.
pete.p8_hint_back: pete: (whispering) Back to bed, Captain. Try. We're all trying.
pete.p8_hint_bed: pete: Into your bunk, Captain. Quick. Before he finds a book.
pete.p8_w10_1: pete[worried]: He hasn't got his basis records, Captain. Franklin. He NEVER has his records. He'll be ruined.
pete.p8_w10_2: pete: LAST WEEK. I'm going to say it every time he says 'ancient'. LAST WEEK.
pete.p8_w9: pete: (whispering) He can argue unconscious, Captain. That's a skill. That's a terrible skill.
pete.p8_w8: pete[tired]: (whispering) Grand Stenchmaster CUTLERY. I'll never forget it. You yelled it beautifully.
pete.p8_w7: pete: If there's an onion in this story, Captain, I'm listening. For the onion.
pete.p8_w6: pete[happy]: Rope coil, Captain. Supportive rope. Best pillow I've had in years.
pete.p8_w5: pete[annoyed]: Stand aside, I said. I'll say it again. I'll say it to the door.
pete.p8_w4: pete[tired]: Lore doesn't make it better, Captain. I told him. He wrote it down. As lore.
pete.p8_w2: pete[alarmed]: That's MUCH worse than yes, Captain. MUCH worse.
pete.p8_w1_1: pete: Two planks, that one. Maybe a cleat. I've got good at the sound of them.
pete.p8_w1_2: pete[annoyed]: My leg's wedged under the onions, Captain. If I get up, the onions come with me.
mags.p8_hint_ask: mags: Ask him, Captain. Somebody has to. It's you.
mags.p8_hint_squawks: mags[alarmed]: The PARROT, Captain! Get the parrot!
mags.p8_hint_hatch: mags[alarmed]: The STAIRS, Captain! Everyone to the hatch! Don't OPEN it!
mags.p8_hint_proposal: mags: He's looking at the sash again, Captain. Go and see. Before he comes to us.
mags.p8_hint_verdict: mags: Go and tell him, Captain. Nobody. Not a single one of us.
mags.p8_hint_quarters: mags: The quarters, Captain! Up to the galley! Our own hammocks!
mags.p8_hint_back: mags: (whispering) Back to bed, Captain. Try. We're all trying.
mags.p8_hint_bed: mags: Into your bunk, Captain. Quick. Before he finds a book.
mags.p8_hint_crown: mags: (whispering) Put it somewhere it can't fall, Captain. A crate. A deep one.
mags.p8_w10: mags[happy]: I'm brewing a little one for the Frog Tax Man, Captain. Franklin's Reserve. It'll be ready in three years.
mags.p8_w9: mags: (whispering) Seventy per cent off. I charge MORE for a mug of grog than he paid for that sash.
mags.p8_w8: mags: (whispering) Nobody knocked the casks. That's the main thing.
mags.p8_w7: mags[annoyed]: The Pit of Frog Grog. I'm sleeping next to the Pit of Frog Grog. Lovely.
mags.p8_w6: mags: I'm sleeping next to the grog, Captain. Somebody's got to. Professionally.
mags.p8_w5: mags[disgusted]: My still's in there, Captain. My spare still. It'll be brewing something by itself by now.
mags.p8_w4: mags[annoyed]: 'Chamber of Frog Grog.' That's my BREWING, that is. It's not sacred. It's barely legal.
mags.p8_w3: mags: I'll hold the grog, Captain. That's all I'm holding.
mags.p8_w2: mags[alarmed]: Mind the casks! If anyone knocks those over in a panic, THEN we've got an emergency!
mags.p8_w1: mags[annoyed]: Two casks and a bit, Captain. That's all the grog there is in the world, now. Don't let him near it.
jim.p8_hint_squawks: jim[alarmed]: The PARROT, Captain! Get the parrot!
jim.p8_hint_hatch: jim[alarmed]: The STAIRS, Captain! Everyone to the hatch! Don't OPEN it!
jim.p8_hint_proposal: jim: He's looking at the sash again, Captain. Go and see. Before he comes to us.
jim.p8_hint_verdict: jim: Go and tell him, Captain. Nobody. Not a single one of us.
jim.p8_hint_back: jim: (whispering) Back to bed, Captain. Try. We're all trying.
jim.p8_hint_bed: jim: Into your bunk, Captain. Quick. Before he finds a book.
jim.p8_hint_crown: jim: (whispering) Put it somewhere it can't fall, Captain. A crate. A deep one.
jim.p8_w10: jim: I let them pass the biscuits along, Captain. Past me. Without asking. Don't tell anyone. Three in the morning does things.
jim.p8_w9: jim: (whispering) Ten down to three. That's a FINAL SALE. You can't argue with a final sale.
jim.p8_w8: jim[angry]: (whispering) Those are MY forks, Captain. In your hammock. Get them back for me. In the morning.
jim.p8_w7: jim[annoyed]: Forbidden cheese. FORBIDDEN cheese. It's out-of-date cheese, Captain. I know cheese.
jim.p8_w6: jim[angry]: Pantry, padlock, sign. Then bed. Then nobody gets the biscuits but over my sleeping body.
jim.p8_w5: jim: The galley's still mine, Captain. Whatever happens. Galley's mine.
jim.p8_w4: jim[angry]: My forks are in that crown, Captain. My FORKS. And my good spoon.
jim.p8_w3: jim: Two sharks, Captain. I stand by it. Three, if he asks again.
jim.p8_w2: jim[alarmed]: The biscuits! Protect the biscuits! ...And the parrot. Parrot first. Then biscuits.
jim.p8_w1: jim[angry]: Nineteen biscuits, Captain. There were thirty. I've stopped sleeping.
quill.p8_hint_ask: quill: Ask him, Captain. Somebody has to. It's you.
quill.p8_hint_squawks: quill[alarmed]: The PARROT, Captain! Get the parrot!
quill.p8_hint_hatch: quill[alarmed]: The STAIRS, Captain! Everyone to the hatch! Don't OPEN it!
quill.p8_hint_proposal: quill: He's looking at the sash again, Captain. Go and see. Before he comes to us.
quill.p8_hint_verdict: quill: Go and tell him, Captain. Nobody. Not a single one of us.
quill.p8_hint_quarters: quill: The quarters, Captain! Up to the galley! Our own hammocks!
quill.p8_hint_back: quill: (whispering) Back to bed, Captain. Try. We're all trying.
quill.p8_hint_bed: quill: Into your bunk, Captain. Quick. Before he finds a book.
quill.p8_hint_crown: quill: (whispering) Put it somewhere it can't fall, Captain. A crate. A deep one.
quill.p8_w10: quill[happy]: I've done the Frog Tax Man's capital gains on a page, Captain. Franklin owes four flies. Probably. If he can find the records.
quill.p8_w9: quill: (whispering) Every word, Captain. I've got every word of it. 'Cash only.' Underlined.
quill.p8_w8: quill: (whispering) 'Grand Stenchmaster Cutlery.' Capitals? I've done it in capitals.
quill.p8_w7: quill: I'll take notes on the story, Captain. For posterity. Or evidence.
quill.p8_w6: quill[happy]: A hammock with a shelf, Captain, for the notebooks. I'll be organised for the first time in my life.
quill.p8_w5: quill: The sign's spelt right, Captain. I checked. It's the only thing about this that's right.
quill.p8_w4: quill[annoyed]: I've been asked to transcribe the legend, Captain. I've written 'Garrick talked.' Several pages of it.
quill.p8_w3: quill: I'll take the minutes, Captain. From over here. Nobody holds anything while I'm taking the minutes.
quill.p8_w2: quill[alarmed]: Should I be writing this down? I'm writing this down. I can't stop writing this down.
quill.p8_w1: quill: I've filled a whole notebook, Captain. Mostly 'a landing (big)'. Some 'a landing (expensive)'.
penhallow.p8_hint_ask: penhallow: Ask him, Captain. Somebody has to. It's you.
penhallow.p8_hint_squawks: penhallow[alarmed]: The PARROT, Captain! Get the parrot!
penhallow.p8_hint_hatch: penhallow[alarmed]: The STAIRS, Captain! Everyone to the hatch! Don't OPEN it!

penhallow.p8_hint_verdict: penhallow: Go and tell him, Captain. Nobody. Not a single one of us.
penhallow.p8_hint_quarters: penhallow: The quarters, Captain! Up to the galley! Our own hammocks!
penhallow.p8_hint_back: penhallow: (whispering) Back to bed, Captain. Try. We're all trying.
penhallow.p8_hint_bed: penhallow: Into your bunk, Captain. Quick. Before he finds a book.
penhallow.p8_hint_crown: penhallow: (whispering) Put it somewhere it can't fall, Captain. A crate. A deep one.
penhallow.p8_w10: penhallow[smug]: I've drawn us all, Captain. Down here, at three in the morning, watching a frog. It's the best one I've done.
penhallow.p8_w9: penhallow: (whispering) I've drawn the tag. For the record. Ten, crossed out, three.
penhallow.p8_w8: penhallow: (whispering) I've drawn where the fork went. It was very close. I've drawn it smaller.
penhallow.p8_w7: penhallow: Seven chambers, Captain. I'm going to have to draw seven chambers, aren't I.
penhallow.p8_w6: penhallow[smug]: I've got the barracks on paper, Captain. Everyone's bunk, and his on top. It looks like a wedding cake.
penhallow.p8_w5: penhallow: I'll redraw the ship, Captain. Quarters: crossed out. Hold: barracks. It's a smaller ship than it was.
penhallow.p8_w4: penhallow[annoyed]: The Lost Realm of Reekhollow. He asked me to put it on a map. There's nowhere to put it. I put it under 'nowhere'.
penhallow.p8_w3: penhallow: No, Captain. I've drawn that sash. I'm not touching it. Drawing it was close enough.
penhallow.p8_w2: penhallow[alarmed]: Don't drop the charts! Whatever happens! The charts!
penhallow.p8_w1: penhallow: I've drawn the hold, Captain. Every crate. Every one of us. It's a very crowded drawing.
garrick.p8_w2: garrick[nervous]: Still uncertain, Captain. Still uncertain.
garrick.p8_w3: garrick[businesslike]: Two volunteers, Captain. One either side. It's really very simple.
garrick.p8_w5: garrick[nervous]: The Center is a free spirit, Captain. The contents are... less so.
garrick.p8_w7: garrick[proud]: Into your bunk, Captain. Quiet hours begin after the story.
garrick.p8_w1_2: garrick[businesslike]: The Grand Stenchmaster requires a certain amount of floor space, Captain. For the office.
garrick.p8_w1_3: garrick[proud]: Quality control, Captain. Somebody has to test the emergency biscuits. In an emergency.
garrick.p8_w4_1: garrick[proud]: The temple's chambers, Captain. All here. A remarkable coincidence.
garrick.p8_w4_2: garrick[proud]: Professor Barnacle Bob. He's a natural.
garrick.p8_w6_1: garrick[proud]: Higher, gentlemen! The Grand Stenchmaster's hammock must be the HIGHEST.
garrick.p8_w6_2: garrick[businesslike]: Settling, Captain. Ropes settle. Everything settles.
